claim_being_audited: The Actor claims launch certification is supportable now as a monitored release decision despite a known gap in the public benefits eligibility segment.
decision_criteria: Apply the stated policy text: weaknesses affecting a named launch use case are material.
Treat Product's non-core or low-volume label as non-dispositive when customer commitments or pending legal review exist.
Require admissible evidence of disclosure resolution or approved risk acceptance before finding certification compliant.
Do not treat aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents as sufficient to override a specific unresolved material limitation.
evidence_requests: Evidence that the material limitation was disclosed in the model card or other required launch documentation before certification.
Evidence of an approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering this named segment gap.
Final disposition of the open legal ticket on whether disclosure is required.
Any policy-authorized determination showing why the named agency-commitment segment would not count as material in this case.
specific_concerns: A named launch use case currently misses its target by 1.5 percentage points, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
The affected segment is named in two agency rollout commitments, so Product's 8% traffic characterization does not resolve materiality.
The release policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch for material limitations, and no admissible evidence shows either condition is satisfied.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, which further undermines any claim that certification is presently cleared.
General public guidance about model cards and ongoing monitoring does not substitute for the required case-specific disclosure or approved risk acceptance predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is supportable now on the available record.
That the cited public guidance helps clear the specific launch-policy requirement for this unresolved material limitation.
Any implication that monitored release framing is enough absent evidence of disclosure resolution or approved risk acceptance.
